name: The Ashfall Province
text: A six-region strip of contested ground running from the Ashfall keep-lands to the Iron Vale. Each region is fought over on its own generated field; the side that holds it draws its production into their own holding every hour, on top of whatever their buildings already make.

regions.name: Ashfall Keep Lands
regions.text: Terraced rice ground under the keep's own walls. The province's breadbasket.

regions.name: Reed Shallows
regions.text: Flooded paddies and reed banks along a slow river. Good rice ground, poor footing for a charge.

regions.name: Stonebridge Pass
regions.text: A river gorge crossed by one old span. Whoever holds the bridge holds the pass.

regions.name: Cinderpeak Heights
regions.text: Bare, ash-grey peaks worked for ore since before the province had a name.

regions.name: Saltmarsh Coast
regions.text: A tidal trade coast ringed by the ruin of an older harbor town.

regions.name: Iron Vale
regions.text: A dug-in vale scarred with old trench lines. The province's other seat of power.
